headline: Chest-high-ish S swell — biggest and best of the region today, fish it.
today: Ditch is the standout with a solid S angle pushing to 2.8ft, though the period's short so it's on the punchy side. Wind stays cross out of the WSW/W all day, never great but never a dealbreaker at this size. Grab a fish or groveler and work the tides through the day. Best call of the local spots by a mile today.

daysToWatch.note: Drops to waist-high but dawn is near-glassy with light WNW before the onshore sneaks in. Worth an early check.
Waist-to-chest with cross-off WNW in the morning cleaning it up. Fun early window.
Bumps back to 2.7ft but very short-period and windy by evening. Morning is the window before the W builds.
Small and blown, WNW cross-off screaming at 20-27mph. Skip.
